title: Rigor Mortis
description:
Your flesh has set with the stiffness of the dead. Each time you take damage, you take 1 less in total.

While you are in {{agonie}}, you can give up your turn to make a {{constitution}} + {{volonte}} {{jet}} against a {{dd}} of 20. On a success, you regain 1 {{pdv}}, which ends the state, and you get back on your feet without spending {{deplacement|movement}}. Either way, your turn ends.
